Extract the category-likelihood function from a representation, template, or model

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-methods.R
get_category_likelihood_function.Rd

For NIX, MNIX, and NIW families the returned function evaluates the posterior predictive, which is the category likelihood for those families.

Usage

get_category_likelihood_function(x, ...)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>/<MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_category_likelihood_function(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A category representation, representation template, or cognitive model.

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

A function of (new_data, log, noise_treatment, Sigma_noise) returning category likelihoods.

Examples

mod <- example_mvg_ideal_observer(n_cues = 2)
lik_fn <- get_category_likelihood_function(mod)
lik_fn(matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 1))
#>              /b/         /d/         /g/         /k/          /p/          /t/
#> [1,] 0.001724177 0.001235615 0.000881319 4.81127e-05 8.097206e-05 2.549558e-05
